title: Algal DNA Extraction Using Plant DNAzol Reagent
author: Jennifer H Wisecaver
materials: Get liquid nitrogen if starting from live cells.

Open the Accuri C6 Plus software and open the cell_counts.cit template under Wisecaver/TEMPLATES directory. Count approximately 5000 'cells with chlorophyll' which should correspond to live P. parvum cells with active chloroplasts.

steps.title: Prepare Algal Culture and Cell Counts
steps.instruction: Collect and quantify the algal culture to ensure sufficient cell density.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 500 µL culture in 500 µL algal medium.
Perform a sip clean on the flow cytometer.
Get initial sample weight on the analytical balance (enclosed hood).
Perform cell counts using the flow cytometer (reserve time on Accuri Teams calendar).
Get a post count sample weight on the analytical balance.
Calculate cell density (cells per mL) using the formula: Concentration = Counts / (Weight 1 - Weight 2) * 2.
Place 100 µL of algal sample in a 96-well glass bottom plate and check culture quality using the 60x objective for P. parvum uniformity and contamination.

steps.title: Harvest and Freeze Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the liquid culture and flash freeze the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Collect 50 mL liquid culture (approx. 10-100 million cells) growing exponentially in a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for 4000 x g, 10 minutes.
Pour off the supernatant into a P. pavum waste container.
Flash freeze the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Initial Lysis with DNAzol
steps.instruction: Lysis the frozen pellet using DNAzol reagent.

substeps.instruction: Warm the frozen centrifuge tube by cupping the area around the pellet in the palm of your hand.
As soon as the edges of the pellet begin to melt, add 300 µL DNAzol.
Pipet up and down to dislodge the pellet and transfer to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Incubate on the Hula Mixer for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm, 10 minutes (do not jostle samples when removing).

steps.title: Phase Separation and Aqueous Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA from proteins and lipids using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Transfer approximately 300 µL of the top aqueous phase to a fresh 1.5 mL tube, pipetting slowly to avoid disrupting the interphase.
Add 300 µL chloroform to each sample.
Secure the cap and mix well by vigorously shaking the tube for 00:00:15.
Discard the supernatant by taking off the initial volume with a 1 mL pipette tip and using a 200 µL pipette tip for the last bit of liquid (dispose of in phenol:chloroform waste).
Add 5 µL RNAse A.
Secure the cap and mix well by vigorously shaking the tube for 00:00:15.
Incubate on the ThermoMixer at 500 rpm, 35 °C, for 20 minutes.
Halfway through incubation, remove tubes and shake vigorously for 00:00:15, then return to the ThermoMixer.
Prepare an aliquot of 100% ethanol (300 µL per sample) during the previous incubation.
Add 225 µL of 100% ethanol.
Invert ten times to mix.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm, 4 minutes, orienting the tube so the cap hinge is on the outer edge of the rotor.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Prepare an ethanol and DNAzol wash (1 mL DNAzol mixed with 750 µL ethanol) and a 75% ethanol wash using nuclease free water (300 µL per sample) during previous incubations.
Discard the supernatant using a 1 mL pipette tip, then a 200 µL pipette tip, avoiding the hinge side of the tube.
Add 300 µL of previously prepared DNAzol wash and drag along the top of a tube rack to agitate and dislodge the pellet.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm, 4 minutes (hinge on outer edge).
Discard the supernatant using a 1 mL pipette tip, then a 200 µL pipette tip, avoiding the hinge side.
Add 300 µL 75% ethanol wash and vortex briefly.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm, 4 minutes (hinge on outer edge).

steps.title: Final Recovery and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend the DNA in buffer.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant using a 1 mL pipette tip, then a 200 µL pipette tip, avoiding the hinge side.
Air dry the DNA pellet for 00:05:00 by placing the tube on its side inside a folded kim wipe.
Resuspend sample in 50 µL TE Buffer.
Incubate on the ThermoMixer at 500 rpm, 35 °C, for 5 minutes.
Briefly spin down the tube using a bench top spinner.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Assess DNA concentration and integrity to determine storage or sequencing suitability.

substeps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit.
Assess DNA integrity using the TapeStation (reserve time on TapeStation Teams calendar).

If DIN ≥ 7 and concentration ≥ 20 ng/uL: Cap tube tightly, label cap and side with unique identifier (letter start, max 12 chars), wrap with parafilm, and store in 'Novogene' box in -20 freezer. Update tracking sheet.
If DIN < 7 (no banding) or concentration < 20 ng/uL: Transfer to cryovial, label with date and identifier, and store in 'P.parvum DNA' box in -80 freezer. Note in -80 log book.
If DIN < 7 with banding: Discard sample.
Ensure all chloroform waste is disposed of in the chemical fume hood.
Wipe down the chemical fume hood, benchtop, rotors, and pipettes with 70-75% ethanol.
